rule: mean-rule: the margin clause is judged on the mean of the three seed margins (seeds 13, 17, 23) in [0.30, 0.45]; the ECE clause (0.07 to 0.12), the gate and the pack stay on the shipped seed; cap 1, no retry class; supersedes D-11; run_go true recorded in 15-GAP-OWNER-REPLY.json

authorization.note: the committed declaration carries run_authorized true (owner reply: mean-rule, run-go); no 15-GAP-RUN-GO.json is needed. The materialized first-add blob equals the working file, has exactly one commit and its sha256 equals declaration_sha256; attempt_cap is 1.

defect_reasons: phase: verdict.json phase is 'failed', expected completed or gate_failed
pack-refused: the gate passed but the pack was not accepted and deploy-eligible
control_evaluation.note: control only: the consumed Phase 14 attempt 1 run (a pack-refused defect), evaluated under the committed declaration to prove the declared statistic (seed_mean) is the one the evaluator reads; never evidence of trust and never an attempt of this plan

no-report.rule_reason: exit_class is pass: the gate executed

no-pack.rule_reason: exit_class is pass: the gate executed

crash.rule_reason: exit_class is crash with no gate report and no GATE line

no-fetch.rule_reason: manifest.json is absent (the fetch failed or never ran)

consumption_rule: R = models/decide/<run.name>, evaluated in this order:
1. R/manifest.json absent (the fetch failed or never ran), or R/logs/outcome.json absent or not JSON with a string exit_class -> unresolved.

2. exit_class in {pass, gate_fail}, or R/run/gate-report.json exists, or R/logs/train.log has a line equal to `GATE PASS` or `GATE FAIL` -> consumed (the gate executed; the evaluator judges whatever evidence was fetched, and a missing report or pack record is its `missing-file` defect, final under cap 1).
3. exit_class in {refused, crash} with none of the gate evidence of step 2 -> pre-verdict (not consumed, D-12).
4. Anything else -> unresolved (never counted as not consumed; the plan stops at CHECKPOINT REACHED and the owner decides; nothing is re-run).
